# Grapheway

> Open protocol for AI agents to discover, traverse, and act on website content as a live knowledge graph — no scraping, no fees.

Grapheway turns a website into a typed, live knowledge graph with an open MCP endpoint and a versioned JSON protocol. Agents read nodes and edges instead of scraping HTML; sites expose actions as tools. The core is zero-dependency TypeScript and runs on Node, Bun, Deno and edge runtimes.

## Start

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/6yte96/grapheway): source, issues, releases, and the protocol white paper.
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/grapheway): one package, six subpath exports.
- [Live adoption index](https://6yte96.github.io/grapheway/adopters/): sites that publish an agent surface, with live stars and downloads.
- [Agent Readiness Index](https://6yte96.github.io/grapheway/readiness/): public audit of 30 top documentation sites; average 28/100.
- [White paper](https://github.com/6yte96/grapheway/blob/main/docs/whitepaper.md): the architecture, why graphs beat static files, and the provenance model.

## For agents

- [Discovery card](https://6yte96.github.io/grapheway/.well-known/agent): what this static surface exposes.
- [Agent manifest](https://6yte96.github.io/grapheway/agents.json): capabilities and file locations.
- [Agent skill](https://github.com/6yte96/grapheway/blob/main/packages/grapheway/SKILL.md): how to discover and use a grapheway site.
- [Probe any site](https://github.com/6yte96/grapheway#grapheway-probe--convert-any-website-into-a-graph-for-agents): `npx grapheway probe https://example.com` turns any URL into the same graph surface.

## For site owners

- [One-command setup](https://github.com/6yte96/grapheway#quick-start-app-side): `npx grapheway init` detects the framework and mounts the agent surface.
- [Next.js and edge adapter](https://github.com/6yte96/grapheway/blob/main/packages/grapheway/src/web/adapters.ts): `toFetchHandler` works in the App Router, Cloudflare Workers, Deno and Bun.
- [Live audit and badge](https://github.com/6yte96/grapheway#cli): `npx grapheway audit https://your.site` and `npx grapheway badge --url https://your.site`.

## Agent access

- Generated by grapheway, the open protocol for agent-ready websites. https://github.com/6yte96/grapheway
- Make any website agent-ready in one command: `npx grapheway init`.
